articles.title: HOW AI APPLICATIONS EARN THEIR PREMIUM
articles.summary: Execution, context, proof, and pricing together strengthen the case for buying. Reliable work and trusted context create an advantage. Clear evidence makes value visible, and pricing lets customers share in efficiency gains while rewarding the vendor for improving delivery. Advantages must widen fast for applications to keep earning their premiums.

articles.title: THE MCDONALDIZATION OF VENTURE CAPITAL
articles.summary: A bigger venture fund can change which version of your company an investor wants to back. Venture is splitting between firms seeking exceptional returns and asset managers built to deploy enormous pools of money. Large asset managers can be satisfied doubling or tripling their money, so they favor companies that can absorb billions of dollars in familiar markets. The same incentives push founders toward businesses that fit the next large investor's expectations.

articles.title: WHEN THE MODELS CATCH UP
articles.summary: If the promised outcome depends on future model improvements, start with the work customers can finish today. Products that only demonstrate what might be possible can generate excitement, but back it up with evidence about what customers can finish today, as people pay for what they can accomplish. A useful partial solution can help you gain valuable feedback for the next model iteration. Keep in mind what the business can still offer when competitors can buy access to the same model.

articles.title: BUILDING A GROWTH ENGINE WITH AI AGENTS
articles.summary: Growth is becoming an engineering problem. This post presents a case study of agent-led growth for growth marketing teams experimenting with AI agents. It covers the experiments the team shipped, what worked, and what went wrong. Not everything needs to scale, and not every problem needs AI.

articles.title: INNOVATE ON YOUR OWN BUSINESS TERMS: GOOGLE CLOUD SPEND CAPS NOW GENERALLY AVAILABLE
articles.summary: Google Cloud spend caps now pause eligible services without deleting resources. Caps for AI services trigger within minutes using estimated costs, while reserved Provisioned Throughput keeps running. Teams can apply caps automatically to new sandbox projects through the API and choose whether blocked services resume each month or wait for manual approval.

articles.title: PEOPLE DATA FOR AI AGENTS
articles.summary: Firecrawl provides people data for AI agents. It helps agents find, enrich, or verify professional contacts and high-intent audiences. The service connects to 12 people providers, each callable through the same Firecrawl API key. It can be used for deep research, smarter AI chats, AI agent tools, onboarding, lead enrichment, and much more.

articles.title: INTRODUCING MONITORS V2
articles.summary: Exa Monitors watches the web and delivers only what's new to agents at a chosen interval. It covers Exa's entire index of 211 million businesses, 3.2 million podcast episodes, 1.27 billion product listings, and over 130 million web pages, and only calls agents when something actually changes. Results are published to a webhook, so agents never have to poll. Monitors v2 drops the price of monitors 7x to $2 per 1,000 runs.

articles.title: WHAT CHANNELS GROW WHEN ORGANIC SEARCH SHRINKS?
articles.summary: An email audience is becoming more valuable as organic search sends fewer visitors. An analysis of Similarweb data puts US email traffic up 16.3% in the first eight months of 2026 against the same period last year. Email added more visits than paid search after excluding Google's ad-routing domain, and the median website's email traffic grew 14.7%. The gains include receipts and notifications, so they measure visits rather than new customers. As search becomes less dependable, give potential buyers a reason to keep reading your emails and return directly to your site.

articles.title: OUR ORGANIZATIONS ARE BEING DDOSED FROM THE INSIDE
articles.summary: Organizations are losing attention as everyone within is doing something they think is useful, but all that work draws on the same limited capacity to understand, review, and decide. Just because work exists doesn't mean it's the right thing to do. Output is not proof of value. A working implementation only means that something can be built, not that it should be - some changes have negative value.
